notes.subject: Qaati, Kipodi, Yanocupi, Oreri
notes.rationale: Mariĩtwa ma inyoni ici nĩ me mĩhari: pelican/cormorant, bittern/hedgehog/porcupine, heron/owl, raven — mũtaũri o wothe nĩonanĩte atĩrĩa.

notes.subject: תהו ובהו
notes.rationale: Tohu na bohu nĩ cio icunjĩ cia Kĩambĩrĩria 1:2; Icaki nĩagĩrĩirio na Edomu ũgũa ũrĩa warĩ thĩ ya mbere — maũndũ manini magĩcoke kuuma mbere ya ũthoma, na gĩkũyũ gĩtarĩ na mũhiano wa ndemwa icio.

notes.subject: קו ואבני
notes.rationale: Ũthiiri na mairĩngĩ nĩ ithiomi cia kũgereria kũingĩra nyũmba — nĩguo kũgereria kwa gũtherithia Edomu gĩkuũkitio.

notes.subject: mũndũ
notes.rationale: Kĩhibirania gĩtarĩ na mũciĩ wa nĩahathĩte; gĩcunjĩ kĩmwe kĩngĩtarĩ kĩa Kĩgĩkũyũ kĩongetio thĩinĩ wa ⟨…⟩.

translation: Na nĩcĩmũthamĩkĩrire Qaati na Kipodi, na Yanocupi na Oreri nĩciikaragĩra ho; na ⟨mũndũ⟩ nĩahathĩte igũrũ rĩake ũthiiri wa ũgũa, na mairĩngĩ ma gũtheri.
